definitions.zh: vi. 排队

examples.en: We stood in a queue for tickets.
examples.zh: 我们排队买票。

examples.en: Please queue up at the counter.
examples.zh: 请在柜台前排队。

definitions.en: n. a fine cord of twisted fibers (of cotton or silk or wool or nylon etc.) used in sewing and weaving
definitions.zh: n. 线, 丝, 纤维, 线索

definitions.en: v. pass a thread through
definitions.zh: vt. 穿线于, 穿过, 通过, 用线穿成

definitions.en: v. remove facial hair by tying a fine string around it and pulling at the string
definitions.zh: vi. 穿过

examples.en: She used a needle and thread to sew.
examples.zh: 她用针线缝补。

examples.en: He lost the thread of the story.
examples.zh: 他失去了故事的线索。

definitions.en: n an instance of questioning
definitions.zh: n. 疑问, 疑问号, 质问, 查询

definitions.en: v pose a question
definitions.zh: v. 询问, 质问
[计] 查询

examples.en: I have a query about the bill.
examples.zh: 我对账单有一个疑问。

examples.en: She queried the database for results.
examples.zh: 她查询数据库以获取结果。

definitions.en: n. an intricate network suggesting something that was formed by weaving or interweaving
definitions.zh: n. 网, 蛛丝, 蹼, 织物, 圈套, 卷筒纸

definitions.en: n. an intricate trap that entangles or ensnares its victim
definitions.zh: vi. 结网, 形成网

definitions.en: n. a fabric (especially a fabric in the process of being woven)
definitions.zh: vt. 织蜘蛛网于, 使落入圈套

examples.en: A spider spun a web in the corner.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛在角落里织了一张网。

examples.en: The web of lies was hard to untangle.
examples.zh: 谎言的网很难解开。

definitions.en: n. a substantial amount
definitions.zh: n. 大块, 矮胖的人(或物)
[经] 定样

examples.en: He ate a large chunk of cheese.
examples.zh: 他吃了一大块奶酪。

examples.en: A chunk of the budget went to education.
examples.zh: 预算的一大块用于教育。

definitions.en: n. a pipe used to transport liquids or gases
definitions.zh: n. 管道, 传递途径
[化] 管路; 管线

examples.en: The pipeline carries oil across the country.
examples.zh: 这条管道将石油输送到全国。

examples.en: A gas pipeline was built under the city.
examples.zh: 城市地下建了一条天然气管道。

definitions.en: n. a pre-compiled, pre-linked program that is ready to run under a given operating system; a binary for one operating system will not run on a different operating system
definitions.zh: a. 由两部分组成的, 二进位的, 二元的

definitions.en: a. of or pertaining to a number system have 2 as its base
definitions.zh: [计] 二进制的; 二态的; 二进制, 二进制文件传输类型设置命令

examples.en: Computers use binary code to process data.
examples.zh: 计算机使用二进制代码处理数据。

examples.en: Binary numbers consist of only zeros and ones.
examples.zh: 二进制数字只由零和一组成。

definitions.en: n. the act of mocking or ridiculing
definitions.zh: n. 嘲笑, 戏弄, 模仿

definitions.en: v. treat with contempt
definitions.zh: a. 假的, 伪造的, 模拟的

definitions.en: v. imitate with mockery and derision
definitions.zh: adv. 虚伪地

examples.en: The students mock the new teacher's accent.
examples.zh: 学生们嘲笑新老师的口音。

examples.en: They held a mock election at school.
examples.zh: 他们在学校举行了一次模拟选举。

definitions.en: n. the grammatical arrangement of words in sentences
definitions.zh: n. 句法, 语法, 句子构造

definitions.en: n. a systematic orderly arrangement
definitions.zh: [计] 句法, 语法

examples.en: Good syntax is important in programming.
examples.zh: 好的语法在编程中很重要。

examples.en: The syntax of this sentence is correct.
examples.zh: 这个句子的语法是正确的。

definitions.en: n. an internal representation of the world; an organization of concepts and actions that can be revised by new information about the world
definitions.zh: n. 概要, 图解, 略图
[计] 模式

examples.en: The database schema defines the table structure.
examples.zh: 数据库模式定义了表结构。

examples.en: We need to update the schema for the new data.
examples.zh: 我们需要为新数据更新模式。

definitions.en: v. place troops or weapons in battle formation
definitions.zh: v. 展开, 配置

examples.en: The army will deploy troops tomorrow.
examples.zh: 军队明天将部署部队。

examples.en: We need to deploy our resources wisely.
examples.zh: 我们需要明智地配置资源。

definitions.en: n. a hidden storage space (for money or provisions or weapons)
definitions.zh: n. 隐藏所, 隐藏的粮食或物资, 贮藏物, 高速缓冲存储器

definitions.en: n. (computer science) RAM memory that is set aside as a specialized buffer storage that is continually updated; used to optimize data transfers between system elements with different characteristics
definitions.zh: vt. 隐藏, 窖藏
[计] 高速缓冲存储器, 高速缓冲

examples.en: The computer stores data in a cache.
examples.zh: 计算机将数据存储在缓存中。

examples.en: They found a cache of hidden gold.
examples.zh: 他们发现了一处隐藏的黄金。

definitions.en: n a person who is deemed to be despicable or contemptible
definitions.zh: n. [俚]饭桶

examples.en: Don't be such a git about it.
examples.zh: 别那么饭桶。

examples.en: He called him a git for being rude.
examples.zh: 他因他粗鲁而叫他饭桶。

definitions.en: v. make optimal; get the most out of; use best
definitions.zh: vt. 使完美, 使完善, 充分利用, 乐观地对待, 优化

definitions.en: v. modify to achieve maximum efficiency in storage capacity or time or cost
definitions.zh: vi. 持乐观态度

definitions.en: v. act as an optimist and take a sunny view of the world
definitions.zh: [计] 优化

examples.en: We can optimize the code for speed.
examples.zh: 我们可以优化代码以提高速度。

examples.en: The goal is to optimize resource usage.
examples.zh: 目标是优化资源使用。

definitions.en: v. analyze syntactically by assigning a constituent structure to (a sentence)
definitions.zh: vt. 从语法上分析
[计] 分列

examples.en: The computer can parse this sentence.
examples.zh: 计算机能分析这个句子。

examples.en: Students learn to parse Latin texts.
examples.zh: 学生学习分析拉丁文文本。

definitions.en: v. locate and correct errors in a computer program code
definitions.zh: vt. 除错, 改正有毛病部分, 除去窃听器, 调试
[计] 调试; DOS外部命令:其功能是对命令文件或执行文件进行调试或测试
也可用于编写小的命令文件

examples.en: I need to debug this program today.
examples.zh: 我今天需要调试这个程序。

examples.en: Debugging helps find errors in code.
examples.zh: 调试有助于找到代码中的错误。

definitions.en: n a place where something ends or is complete
definitions.zh: n. 端点；末端, 终结点

examples.en: The API endpoint returns user data.
examples.zh: API端点返回用户数据。

examples.en: Each endpoint has a unique URL.
examples.zh: 每个端点都有一个唯一的URL。

definitions.zh: [计] 应用程序接口, 自动优先中断
[经] 美国石油协会

examples.en: The API allows apps to communicate.
examples.zh: API允许应用程序通信。

examples.en: We use the API to fetch weather data.
examples.zh: 我们使用API获取天气数据。

definitions.zh: 异步的

examples.en: Async programming improves performance.
examples.zh: 异步编程提高性能。

examples.en: This function runs in an async manner.
examples.zh: 这个函数以异步方式运行。

definitions.zh: abbr. 自生的（authentic）；授权的（authorized）

examples.en: Auth is required to access the system.
examples.zh: 需要授权才能访问系统。

examples.en: The auth token expired after one hour.
examples.zh: 授权令牌一小时后过期。

definitions.zh: n. 常量, 常数

examples.en: Use const to declare a constant value.
examples.zh: 使用const声明常量值。

examples.en: The const variable cannot be changed.
examples.zh: 常量变量不能更改。

definitions.zh: n. 相关插件；插件

examples.en: Install the plugin to add new features.
examples.zh: 安装插件以添加新功能。

examples.en: This plugin works with the browser.
examples.zh: 这个插件与浏览器兼容。

definitions.zh: [网络] 重构；重构你的代码；代码重构

examples.en: We need to refactor the old code.
examples.zh: 我们需要重构旧代码。

examples.en: Refactoring improves code readability.
examples.zh: 重构提高代码可读性。
